text_too_small.instructions: state has a short description and one screenshot of one screen of a web page. Look only at the main reading text: paragraphs, list items and card descriptions. Is that text noticeably small for this screen, so that a reader would lean in or zoom to read it comfortably? Ignore labels, captions inside product screenshots, legal lines and text inside images.

heading_imbalance.instructions: Is a heading clearly out of proportion with the text next to it? Examples: a huge title above a tiny subtitle, or a section heading that is barely larger than the paragraph text under it.

cards_misaligned.instructions: Look at boxes, cards, pills or buttons that sit side by side or in a grid. Do they have clearly different heights, top or bottom edges that do not line up, or outer edges that do not line up with the content column above or below them? A row that wraps a last item onto its own centred line counts as misaligned.

uneven_gap.instructions: Is there an awkward empty gap, for example a large blank space between a heading and its own text, or clearly uneven spacing between similar items? Normal space between two separate sections does not count.

long_lines.instructions: Does a paragraph run across almost the whole width of a wide screen, so that each line is very long and hard to follow?

defect_box.instructions: the most visible typography or alignment problem in the website screenshot: text that is too small, cards that do not line up, an oversized title or an awkward empty gap

readability.instructions: How easy is the main text on this screen to read on this device?
criteria: Hard to read: too small, low contrast or cramped
Very easy to read: comfortable size, spacing and contrast

polish.instructions: How polished does this screen look for a professional SEO agency website that sells to large companies?
criteria: Broken: the layout is clearly broken
Excellent: polished, comparable to a top consulting firm
